generation.name: 01-landing
generation.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Deliverable: a final carefully art-directed Korean Salus web/mobile interface design, informed by real research into content-first social interfaces, personal document workspaces, rigorous navigation systems and transparent checkout. Create ORIGINAL Salus design, never reproduce another brand's trade dress.
Identity: a quiet, personal everyday meal workspace. Warm natural white #FAF9F6 canvas, clean white #FFFFFF working surfaces, near-black #26312A text, moss #405D46 for actions, mist sage #EEF2EB for selections, understated stone #DDDFD7 rules, muted amber for unknown information. Flat colors only. Warm but contemporary, not rustic or corporate, not a magazine made entirely of serif text. Premium through painstaking layout and clarity.
Typography: Roman wordmark "Salus" in a compact elegant humanist serif; NO leaf or decorative logo symbol. ALL Korean headings and body use a beautiful modern Korean sans similar to Pretendard, medium weight, impeccable typesetting. Marketing heading 48px equivalent, functional headings 24px, body 15-16px, secondary copy minimum 13px. No handwritten Korean, no serif Korean, no giant heavy black typography, no fake monospace terminal details.
Geometry: consistent 8px spacing rhythm, 48px primary controls, modest 8-12px functional radii, one-pixel separators, very restrained shadows on floating UI only. Do not put every text fragment in a card. Prioritize horizontal alignment, clean text lists, decisive whitespace, few clear actions. No giant vacant canvas. Calm at human scale.
ABSOLUTE visual prohibitions: ZERO photography, ZERO food pictures, ZERO food illustrations, ZERO food icons or silhouettes, ZERO decorative vegetables/plates/cutlery, ZERO mascots, ZERO abstract 3D sculptures/blobs, ZERO gradients or glow, ZERO sparkle/AI star symbols, ZERO ghost thumbnail placeholders, ZERO fake certification/testimonials/usage metrics. Functional simple line icons (search, calendar, bookmark, account, arrows, info, checkboxes) allowed.
Layout: exceptionally crisp landscape 3000x2000 high-resolution composed screenshot. Desktop design on left 74%, matching realistic 390px-wide mobile design on right 26%, separated by 24px stone-white gutter. Both are straight-on fully legible UI screens, no device hardware, no perspective, no Figma labels or presentation commentary. Fit both viewports without cropping controls. All copy Korean except Salus, Google, PLUS.
System consistency: identical wordmark, action color, border radius and Korean type family on every screen. Authenticated app nav exactly 요리 찾기 / 식사 기록 / 내 레시피 / 건강 정보, in this order; do not add shopping lists, community or unrelated features. Mobile nav uses the same four labels with simple line icons. Marketing nav 이용 방법 / 요금 안내 / 로그인 / 시작하기.
Trust: content is an example, never claim a recipe is safe, medically recommended, verified when not supported. Unknown allergies are shown as unknown, not checked-safe. Sources have neutral links. Safety checks remain equal for free and PLUS.

SCREEN: the definitive Salus landing page. Strong, welcoming, photograph-free hero that lets users immediately understand AND try product.
Header 72px equivalent with Salus left, sparse marketing nav right, dark moss small 시작하기 button. Maxwidth grid generous but not huge.
Hero upper left: tiny olive plain eyebrow "매일의 식사, 나에게 맞게"; beautiful moderately large sans headline exactly "오늘의 한 끼를,\n나에게 맞게." Short readable subcopy "집에 있는 재료와 내 취향으로 요리를 찾고,\n먹은 식사는 차곡차곡 기록해요." Under that one clear moss button "내 재료로 요리 찾기 →"; quiet text "로그인 없이 먼저 둘러볼 수 있어요".
Hero right: not an illustration but a polished REAL functional product preview on white surface, slightly elevated by fine border. Header "어떤 재료가 있나요?" then active multiline input with exact value "두부와 달걀로 간단한 저녁을 만들고 싶어요." bottom submit arrow. Under thin rule result small label "이런 요리를 찾을 수 있어요", recipe title "두부 달걀 덮밥", inline meta "15분 · 1인분", tiny secondary "두부 · 달걀 · 밥 · 대파". Footer row neutral amber dot "알레르기 정보 미입력" and "재료와 만드는 법 →" link. This is the hero's visual anchor, perfectly aligned and not a tiny UI lost on the page.
Across hero bottom small plain secondary action strip like a calm editorial index "재료로 찾기 ↗   /   먹고 싶은 요리로 찾기 ↗   /   저장한 요리 보기 ↗", under a hairline.
Second section compact heading "한 끼를 찾는 일부터, 기록까지." Three equal unboxed columns with simple tiny number 01 02 03, headings "내 조건을 알려주고" "먹고 싶은 요리를 고르고" "오늘의 식사로 남겨요"; one sentence each. No pictures or decorative icons.
Lower section title "복잡하게 시작하지 않아도 괜찮아요." and a meaningful text-only example meal log: date "10월 30일 금요일", rows "아침  아직 기록이 없어요  + 기록" "점심  두부 달걀 덮밥  기록 보기 →" "저녁  오늘 먹을 요리 찾기 →". Frame once as a useful horizontal component not 3 marketing cards. It demonstrates the second core function in the same visual system.
Small clean footer Salus and 이용약관 개인정보처리방침.
Mobile actual responsive version: same hero heading, CTA and product preview within 24px padding, then compact three-step list, no duplicate navigation inside preview. No food images or decorative substitutes.
